message.name: CashDepositOrWithdrawalStatusUpdateV01
message.definition: The CashDepositOrWithdrawalStatusUpdate message reports the status of a cash deposit request or cash withdrawal request.|Where reporting on the status of a cash deposit request, it is sent by a cash receiver to a cash sender.|Where reporting on the status of a cash withdrawal request, it is sent by a cash sender to a cash receiver.

rules.name: StatusReasonRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionRule
rules.text: If Description is present, then Status/Code is not allowed.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.
